understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each KA59 level by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked `+` was simultaneously occupied by a selectable piece, producing a WIN state before the step budget ran out.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces could be controlled either by selecting them (via CLICK on a piece’s coordinate) and then moving with directional actions, or by using CLICK interactions that attempted to move/teleport the currently selected piece to the clicked target when permitted by the level’s rules. Movement was constrained by walls/obstacles (and possibly other pieces), so attempts to move into blocked cells had no effect, and each action consumed one step from the level’s finite step budget.
